# netactuate_server_disks (Data Source)

Reads Server Disks visible to the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_server_disks" "example" {
  mbpkgid = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mbpkgid` (Number) Server package ID whose cloud disks should be read.

### Read-Only

- `disks` (List of Object) List of cloud disks for the server. The live endpoint returned only empty lists when this data source was added, so no per-disk fields are exposed yet. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--disks))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
